seo.title: Careers at Advia | Advia
seo.description: Open positions at Advia, an AdTech founded in Madrid in 2024. What we build, how we work and how our hiring process runs.

hero.titular: Build with us the advertising that answers a <key>question</key>
hero.lede: We are an AdTech founded in Madrid in 2024. We use AI agents to find the moment someone researches before deciding, and place brands there as the answer. We are looking for people who can't stop thinking about that problem.

items.texto: We move fast and everyone contributes in their own way. Here you grow by doing.
We built Vera so the team can go further, not to take away its judgement.
We say what we see, with the data in front of us, even when it's not what anyone wanted to hear.
We are 12 people. What each of us does shows in everyone's result.

proceso.titular: Four steps and an <key>answer</key> at each one
proceso.lede: We tell you where you stand. If we don't move forward, we tell you that too.

pasos.texto: You send your CV and answer the questions in the job post. We reply within 5 working days.
A 30-minute video call with one of the founders, to get to know each other and answer your questions about the role.
A case close to the real work, which you present in a one-hour session with the team you'd join.
You spend a morning at our Madrid office with the people you'd work with. If it's a fit on both sides, we make you a written offer.

proceso.cierre: From start to finish, about 3 weeks.

posiciones.vacio: We have no open positions right now. If the problem interests you, write to careers@advia.tech and tell us what you'd like to build.
posiciones.error: We couldn't load the positions. Try again in a few minutes or write to careers@advia.tech.

fraude: We will only ever write to you from an @advia.tech address, and we will never ask you for money or bank details during the process.

form.lede: It takes about 5 minutes. Just your CV and the questions for the role; no cover letters.
